title: Processing engine job
description: What the processing engine (osb-engine) is asked to do with one recording. Written by whatever starts the engine: the Mac app, the cloud job, or a person at a terminal.

recording.description: Folder holding the merged manifest.json and every segment file at its objectKey. Relative paths are relative to the job file. The engine writes its own files inside it (engine/, phase0/, pitch/, teams/, detect/, follow/, fullgame/).

height.description: game.mp4's height. 1440 scales the 1080p render up, which YouTube serves with a better codec and bitrate.

youtubeCopy.description: With height 1080: also write game-youtube.mp4 beside game.mp4, the same video scaled up to 1440p. YouTube serves a 1440p upload with a better codec and a much higher bitrate than a 1080p one; game.mp4 stays the smaller file to keep and play. About half an hour and 23 GB more for 100 minutes. Ignored at height 1440, where game.mp4 is that file.

chunkS.description: The game is processed in chunks this long; a stopped run resumes at the first unfinished chunk.

maxChunks.description: Only this many chunks (0: all). For tests.

sample.description: Where the pitch and the kit groups are fitted. Default: a quarter of the way into the recording.

keepIntermediates.description: Keep fullgame/pieces/, video.mp4 and audio.m4a after game.mp4 is written and checked (by default they are deleted: ~23 GB for 100 minutes). For tests.
